# Every config key checkpointz v0.32.0 reads, from the yaml tags of its
# config structs: pkg/checkpointz/config.go (global, beacon),
# pkg/beacon/config.go (checkpointz), pkg/beacon/node/config.go (upstreams)
# and pkg/beacon/store/config.go (max_items). metricsAddr is parsed but
# never used: v0.32.0 opens no metrics listener. Keys marked "unused:"
# appear in example_config.yaml but no struct reads them; jumpgate never
# renders them.
global
global.listenAddr
global.logging
unused: global.metricsAddr
checkpointz
checkpointz.mode
checkpointz.custom_preset
checkpointz.caches
checkpointz.caches.blocks
checkpointz.caches.blocks.max_items
checkpointz.caches.states
checkpointz.caches.states.max_items
checkpointz.caches.deposit_snapshots
checkpointz.caches.deposit_snapshots.max_items
checkpointz.caches.blob_sidecars
checkpointz.caches.blob_sidecars.max_items
checkpointz.historical_epoch_count
checkpointz.frontend
checkpointz.frontend.enabled
checkpointz.frontend.public_url
checkpointz.frontend.brand_name
checkpointz.frontend.brand_image_url
beacon
beacon.upstreams
beacon.upstreams[].name
beacon.upstreams[].address
unused: beacon.upstreams[].timeoutSeconds
beacon.upstreams[].dataProvider
beacon.upstreams[].headers
